messages:
Julia: Quick design thread — thinking through the sidebar regroup and deep-link behavior for the Console nav. Sketch attached: https://img.redwood.dev/console-nav-sketch.png 
Mike: Looks good overall. main ask: make it obvious where "Projects" vs "Deployments" live. currently they feel duplicated across Observability/Runtime. :thinking_face:
Anna: Proposal: collapse 'Monitoring' + 'Alerts' under an 'Observability' parent, keep 'Deployments' under 'Runtime' only. reduces cross-targeting when users search. :white_check_mark:
Anna: Breadcrumbs: when you deep-link into a modal/panel (eg /projects/123/versions?panel=diff) breadcrumb should still show Project > Versions and not the panel query. avoid breadcrumb pollution.
Devon: Agree. Technically easiest is to treat panels as substate, not route segments. we can keep canonical route at /projects/:id/versions and use ?panel=.
Devon: Quick router snippet for discussion:
```
{
  path: '/projects/:id/versions',
  component: VersionsPage,
  meta: { breadcrumb: ['Projects','Versions'] }
}
// panels -> open via query string ?panel=diff or hash #diff
```
Sasha: +1. Also — deep links from email should be resilient if user lacks perms. fallback to project list with a toast: "You don't have access to Project X" rather than a 404. small copy tweak there.
Mike: Accessibility nit: keyboard focus should land on the main heading after navigation, not the sidebar. otherwise screen-reader users lose context.
Anna: Good catch. we'll add focus management in the router change. also include skip-link: "Skip to main" in header for a11y.
Devon: One implementation question — if we keep panels as query/hash, do we still want shareable URLs for specific panel states? hashes are fine, but query strings are better for server-side analytics. pref to use query params so analytics and caching can handle it.
Julia: UX ask: when sidebar groups collapse, preserve user preference (persist in localStorage + server setting for logged-in). otherwise toggling during rollout will annoy power users.
Sasha: For copy — change sidebar item 'Instances' -> 'Compute instances' to reduce ambiguity. tiny but reduces support pings.
ops-bot: deploybot: note — frontend branch "nav-refactor/202" has a staging build at https://stg-console.redwood.dev (expires in 48h). :robot_face:
Devon: Pushed initial PR with route changes, left TODOs for focus/skip-link and persisted collapse. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2241
Julia: Great, can designers QA the staging build next MON? @Anna @Mike please confirm.
Anna: I can get initial pass Friday EOD then more thorough Monday.
Mike: I'll run keyboard-nav/a11y checks Monday as well.
Sasha: I'll draft the fallback copy and microcopy changes, share in this thread before Monday.
Julia: Cool — goal: land routing + breadcrumbs + persisted groups in first rollout, panels as query param in second. thanks all. :rocket:
